post.summary: Get the salt to derive an account backup's keys
post.description: Body: {"account": username or 64-hex public ID}. Always answers {"salt": 32 hex}: the stored backup's salt, or a stable decoy when no backup is stored or nobody holds the name, so the answer does not tell which names keep a backup. Limited to 60 requests a minute per address.

post.summary: Release an account backup for a password's login proof
post.description: Body: {"account", "proof": 64 hex}. The node stores only SHA-256 of the proof and compares it in constant time. Returns {"account_id", "backup"}: the backup text sealed on the device with Argon2id, which the node cannot open. A wrong proof, an unknown name and an account without a backup all answer 403 {"error": "wrong username or password"}. Five wrong proofs are free; the fifth locks for 60 seconds and each further one doubles the lock, up to 24 hours. Locks are kept in the database and survive a restart; a right proof clears them. While locked: 429 {"error": "too many attempts", "retry_after": seconds}. Limited to 20 requests a minute per address.

Bearer token. Body: {"backup": waozi-account-backup-v3 text up to 17664 bytes, "salt": 32 hex, "verifier": 64 hex SHA-256 of the login proof}. The backup must use ML-DSA-44 and Argon2id with 65536 KiB, 3 passes and 1 lane, and its salt line must equal salt. Replaces any stored backup and clears its failed attempts. Not counted as account storage and not replicated to other nodes. Returns {"stored": true, "updated_at"}.

get.summary: Show whether the signed-in account keeps a backup here
get.description: Bearer token. Returns {"stored": bool, "updated_at": Unix seconds, 0 when none}.

delete.description: Bearer token. Returns {"deleted": bool}. Deleting the account also deletes its backup.
